CONTROLS

Online: both players use the Player 1 keys on their own device; the joining player controls P2. Online matches keep running while menus are open. Player 1 can also use J / K / L / U for actions. WASD also moves Player 1 in solo modes. Player 2 can use 1 / 2 / 3 / 0 for actions.

Phone: slide your left thumb across the D-pad. Up jumps; down blocks. Use the right buttons to attack. GRAB changes to PIN beside a downed opponent and BREAK when you are grabbed. Tap KICK OUT repeatedly when pinned.

Hold a direction to build into a run. For the expanded roster, WEAPON cycles bare hands, chair, bat, guitar and trash can. HEAVY uses your equipped gear; a guitar breaks after two landed attacks. TAUNT earns 12 meter if you finish it safely.

At either corner with space from your opponent, GRAB becomes CLIMB. At the top, tap Jump or an attack to dive; use FINISH with full meter for a stronger dive. Down climbs off. A missed or blocked dive leaves you down and open to a pin.

Grapple close to throw. Hold Down + GRAB beside a downed opponent for a submission hold. Alternate strike and heavy to escape pins or submissions on keyboard or gamepad; on phone, tap the large ESCAPE button. Fill the LUNACY meter, then use your finisher close to your opponent. PRACTICE gives you a passive opponent and full meter.

Gamepad: stick / D-pad to move, A jump, X strike, Y heavy, B grapple, LB block, RB finisher, LT weapon, RT taunt, Start pause.
